value.body: The Master of Physical Education (M.P.Ed) is a two-year master's taken after a B.P.Ed. It goes deeper into exercise physiology, sports training, biomechanics, research methods and teacher education, and is the usual base for college teaching and research in physical education.

items.label: Share of women

value.title: How you get in
value.body: University entrance tests, CUET-PG at some central universities, or merit in the B.P.Ed. Many institutes also hold a physical fitness test.

value.title: At a glance
items: UGC-NET in Physical Education is commonly taken after the M.P.Ed for lecturer posts.
Some state teacher-recruitment rules count it for senior physical education posts.
A PhD in physical education usually follows an M.P.Ed.

value.title: M.P.Ed enrolment
value.note: Counts only programmes recorded as M.P.Ed; M.P.E. and M.P.E.S. are listed separately in AISHE. Based on institutions that responded to the survey.
